Name: RSV - More Seasonal Outfits for Sean
Author: VinillaBean
Description:
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][color=#e06666][size=4][b]About[/b][/size][/color][/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]
This mod gives Sean, one of the bachelors from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] mod, more seasonal outfits to wear. Included is one new outfit per season and a Spirit's Eve costume (with new dialogue to match his costume). For his day-to-day outfits, he has a random chance of wearing his hair in a longer style rather than it being tied up in a bun (50% chance each day, changed to ~33% when the official seasonals are also used).

[color=#e06666][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
This mod is compatible with the 1.6 version of Stardew Valley. Please be sure to update Ridgeside to the latest version that is also compatible with 1.6. For those who are still playing 1.5.6, a working version for that can be found in the old files section. I [i]highly[/i] recommend updating to the latest version for better compatibility with the official [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18202]Ridgeside Seasonals[/url] mod.

[color=#e06666][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color]
You can install this mod by downloading it and unzipping into your Mods folder. Be sure you also have the latest version of Ridgeside Village and all of its requirements as well! You can remove this mod at any time by removing or deleting it from your Mods folder.

[color=#e06666][size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size][/color]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url] and the rest of the Ridgeside Council for creating all of the wonderful Ridgeside Village mod, including my favorite pun slinger Sean~

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]Airyn[/url] for giving me lots, and lots, of art help and advice. Especially with that infernal hat in the Spirit's Eve costume.

All my other friends for giving me their opinions and thoughts on the outfits as I worked on them!
[/font]
